Before you contact us

Common questions

What upholstery services are available in Vaughan?

Nora’s Upholstery works on dental and medical seating, chiropractic tables, residential furniture, restaurant and hospitality seating, fitness equipment and other commercial seating.

Do you offer pickup and delivery in Vaughan?

Pickup and delivery may be available. We confirm logistics after reviewing the location, access, number of pieces, project type and schedule.

What should I send for an estimate?

Send clear photos of the complete piece and damaged areas, the quantity, your city or postal code, desired timing and any material or colour preferences.
